playoff.entries: 3rd-8th: 5th v 8th and 6th v 7th single leg, then semi-finals and final
playoff.note: Preliminary round is a single leg at the better-placed club; semi-finals and final are two legs. A level aggregate sends the better-placed club through. 3rd is promoted directly instead if at least 15 points clear of 4th. Not the relegation play-out (16th v 17th), which is recorded on the 1-2/2-3 boundaries.

playoff.entries: 2nd-10th of each of the 3 groups (27 clubs) plus the Coppa Italia Serie C winner
playoff.note: Competition-wide, not per group: group phase single leg (4th-10th), national phase two legs (3rd places enter round 1, 2nd places round 2), Final Four two legs. One promoted club.

boundaries.note: Serie B: top 2 direct, 3rd-8th play off for the third place (3rd direct if 15+ points clear of 4th). Serie A: 18th-20th relegated directly, no play-out.

Serie C: one direct promotion per group (3) plus the national play-off winner (1). Serie B: 18th-20th direct plus 16th v 17th play-out (skipped if 17th is 5+ points behind 16th, then 17th goes down). The four relegated clubs are placed into Serie C groups A/B/C by geography with no quota; 2026-27 was A 0, B 3, C 1.

conflicts.real: one 60-club Serie C with 3 geographical groups of 20
conflicts.note: Sizes and levels are correct, but the three rows share one promotion play-off, one relegation play-out and a yearly geographical re-draw of clubs between groups. Do not treat them as closed leagues with a fixed 1-up-1-down each.

notes: Serie C is one 60-club league with three geographical groups (A north, B centre, C south); IT3A-IT3C are groups, not separate competitions, and the play-off/play-out are competition-wide. Level 4 is Serie D (9 groups A-I, not modelled): its 9 group winners are promoted and Serie C's 9 relegated clubs enter it, with group placement by geography (2026-27 was 3 per group). Counts are nominal: the Serie B play-off place vanishes if 3rd is 15+ points clear of 4th, the Serie B play-out place vanishes if 17th is 5+ points adrift, and Serie C play-outs are skipped when the gap exceeds 8 points.
